summary: From 2025 H1 to 2025 H2, total revenue changed +3.3% ($47.80M to $49.38M) and profit changed +3.6%. 7 issues detected (5 high, 1 medium, 1 low severity). Most severe: South / Laptop Pro return rate rose from 4.7% (2025 H1) to 8.5% (2025 H2), +3.8 pp (+80.5% relative, z = 4.8). Top recommendation: Investigate product quality, fulfillment, or customer experience for South / Laptop Pro before increasing inventory or marketing spend.
